name: @pipeworx/mcp-idigbio

tools.name: search_specimens
tools.description: Search ~150M digitized natural-history museum specimen records (plants, animals, fossils) from US collections via iDigBio. Filter by any combination of taxonomy and locality. At least one filter is required. Keyless.

scientific_name.description: Scientific name, e.g. "puma concolor", "quercus alba". Matched case-insensitively.

tools.name: get_specimen
tools.description: Get the full normalized record for a single iDigBio specimen by its uuid. e.g. uuid "0746b188-c390-4ab1-bd20-5489a9c6c33c" (a Puma concolor record). Keyless.

tools.name: count_by_field
tools.description: Get taxonomic/geographic specimen counts grouped by a field (top values + counts) across iDigBio. Optionally scope the counts with taxonomy/locality filters. Keyless.

field.description: Field to group by: one of country, stateprovince, family, genus, institutioncode, basisofrecord.

scientific_name.description: Optional filter to scope the counts.

genus.description: Optional filter to scope the counts.

family.description: Optional filter to scope the counts.

country.description: Optional filter to scope the counts.

top_count.description: Number of top buckets to return (default 10, max 25).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-idigbio forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the idigbio pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
